plugin.name: Visual FX Frame
plugin.description: Broadcast-safe WebGL effects with live triggers, presets and transparent OBS output.

labels.aktuelle_einstellungen_als_preset_speich: Save current settings as a preset:
labels.die_vorschau_zeigt_die_layer_hierarchie_: The preview shows the layer hierarchy in real time. Make sure that the content zone remains free and only the outer edges are alive.
labels.in_obs_eine_neue_browser_source_erstelle: Create a new browser source in OBS
labels.starke_des_3d_tiefeneffekts_zwischen_ebe: Strength of 3D depth effect between layers
labels.wahle_ein_preset_oder_passe_die_regeln_u: Choose a preset or customize the rules below. The result is always readable first, then loud.
labels.wahle_die_rolle_des_overlays: Choose the role of the overlay:
labels.reagiere_auf_tiktok_live_events_mit_klar: Respond to TikTok LIVE events with clearly defined visual signatures for moments big and small.
labels.shutdown_source_when_not_visible_deaktiv: Disable “Shutdown source when not visible” (for better performance)
labels.fugt_eine_organische_krummung_zum_rahmen: Adds an organic curvature to the frame
labels.breite_und_hohe_entsprechend_deiner_ausw: Adjust width and height according to your selection
labels.broadcast_safe_webgl_frame_system_mit_kl: Broadcast-safe WebGL frame system with clear layer hierarchy, live preview and direct trigger reactions for TikTok LIVE and OBS.
labels.die_ausgabe_ist_auf_lesbarkeit_getrimmt_: The output is trimmed for readability: a calm base layer, short accent reactions and rare impact moments for big TikTok events.
labels.mehr_ebenen_mehr_tiefe_aber_niedrigere_p: More layers = more depth, but lower performance
labels.obs_safe_ist_der_default_low_load_ist: OBS-safe is the default, low load is the emergency brake for weak hardware.
labels.analoges_film_rauschen_fur_organischeren: Analog film noise for a more organic look
labels.nutze_kurze_pulse_und_partikel_fuer_klei: Use short pulses and particles for small gifts, likes and follow spikes.
labels.passt_details_automatisch_an_die_auflosu: Automatically adjusts details based on resolution
labels.grosse_gifts_shares_oder_manuelle_tests_: Large gifts, shares or manual tests only draw lightning and strong bloom spikes for a few seconds.
labels.der_grundzustand_bleibt_ruhig_sauber_und: The basic state remains calm, clean and permanently legible. This means the overlay doesn't appear overloaded even in long sessions.
labels.definiere_position_und_groesse_so_dass_k: Define the position and size so that the camera, facecam or gameplay do not interfere with the effect.
labels.bestimmt_die_bewegungskurve_der_animatio: Determines the movement curve of the animations
labels.follows_likes_und_kleine_gifts_loesen_ku: Follows, likes and small gifts trigger short pulses and color pulses without covering the content zone.
labels.reserviere_lightning_und_starke_bloom_sp: Reserve lightning and strong bloom spikes for the really big moments.
labels.transparenter_hintergrund_ist_bereits_ak: Transparent background is already activated and OBS-safe ✅
labels.ab_welcher_helligkeit_der_bloom_effekt_e: At what brightness the bloom effect begins
labels.erzeugt_einen_intensiven_glow_effekt_um_: Creates an intense glow effect around bright areas
labels.hohere_werte_mehr_details_aber_niedriger: Higher values = more details, but lower performance
labels.content_bleibt_in_der_mitte_frei_waehren: Content remains free in the middle, while the effects react at the edges, in the frame and during triggers with a short duration.
labels.verbessert_die_visuelle_qualitat_auf_kos: Improves visual quality at the expense of more GPU memory
labels.der_katalog_dient_als_trigger_landkarte_: The catalog serves as a trigger map for reward, accent and impact rules.
labels.presets_sichern_komplette_looks_fuer_unt: Presets ensure complete looks for different show phases: quiet, clean, hectic or maximally loud.
labels.mindestabstand_zwischen_triggern_gleiche: Minimum distance between triggers of the same type (anti-spam)
labels.starke_des_tiefeneffekts_im_gesamten_bil: Amount of depth effect throughout the image
labels.viewer_konnen_via_chat_nachricht_die_eff: Viewers can change the effect color via chat message
labels.maximale_anzahl_gleichzeitig_aktiver_tri: Maximum number of trigger effects active at the same time
labels.steuert_wie_weich_die_effekte_an_den_kan: Controls how smoothly the effects fade at the edges
labels.fugt_rauschen_an_den_rahmenkanten_fur_or: Adds noise to the frame edges for a more organic look
labels.jeder_modus_hat_eine_klare_aufgabe_grund: Each mode has a clear task: basic mood, reaction peak or impact moment. This keeps the center calm and the edges provide the energy.
labels.halte_die_grundbewegung_ruhig_und_die_ka: Keep the basic movement smooth and the edges clean so that the stream always remains readable.
labels.farbverschiebung_an_kanten_retro_kamera_: Color shift on edges (retro camera effect)
